student_learning_goal: I can model a real-life community situation from my own life.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can model a real-life community situation from my own life.
header.character_watermark: Coach Cara and Sport Sam together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a community topic. Draw or write 1 sentence describing the situation.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Topic title slot and description box.

image_placeholders.description: A topic title slot 'My Topic: ___' with description box and small drawing area in B&W, ~7in x 1.5in. Header 'Part 1: Situation'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_TOPIC: keywords (topic, situation) name the box.

parts.student_instructions: Write a math question about your situation.

image_placeholders.description: A long question slot in B&W, ~7in x 1in. Header 'Part 2: Math Question'. 'My question: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_Q: keywords (math, question) name the slot.

parts.student_instructions: Collect or imagine data. Use big numbers.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. A data area with grid.

image_placeholders.description: A data area in B&W, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Part 3: Data'. Tally box and table space.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_DATA: keywords (data, tally) name the area.

parts.student_instructions: Predict for a big community-scale time span (4 weeks, 1 season).

image_placeholders.description: A prediction slot in B&W, ~7in x 1in. Header 'Part 4: Prediction'. 'My prediction: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_PREDICTION: keywords (my, prediction) name the slot.

parts.student_instructions: Would your model need refining? Why?

image_placeholders.description: A reflection box in B&W, ~7in x 1.5in. 'My model needs refining because: ___'. Header 'Part 5: Reflection'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P5_REFLECT: keywords (my, reflection) name the box.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and read each other's models.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use as integrated C4 evidence.
